hosts.title: Servers
hosts.description: Every Docker host this dashboard reads. Install docker-dash on another machine, allow it to be read from its own dashboard, and add it here.
hosts.name: Name
hosts.urlHint: Where the remote docker-dash answers, for example http://192.168.1.10:3080 or a Tailscale name.
hosts.hostnameHint: Hostname used to open this server's containers by port, when its services are not published on the same address as its dashboard.
hosts.deleteConfirm: Remove "{{name}}"? Its shortcuts on this dashboard go with it. The server itself and its containers are left untouched.
hosts.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key
hosts.apiKeyHint: Open that server's own dashboard, allow it to be read, and copy its key from the Servers panel. It is never sent back to the browser.

agent.allowHub: Let another dashboard read this server
agent.managedByEnv: Set by the API_KEY environment variable, so it cannot be changed here.
agent.keyHint: Paste this key into the other dashboard when you add this server.
agent.copyFailed: Your browser would not give access to the clipboard. The key is now shown in full - select and copy it by hand.
agent.rotateConfirm: Replace this server's API key? Any dashboard still using the old key stops being able to read this server until you paste the new one.

errors.no_url: This server has no address configured.
errors.key_rejected: The API key was rejected. Copy the key from that server's own dashboard, under Servers.
errors.not_an_agent: That server is not set up to be read. In its own dashboard, under Servers, tick “let another dashboard read this server” - and make sure it runs docker-dash 0.3 or newer.
errors.bad_response: That server answered something unexpected. Is the address pointing at docker-dash?
errors.refused: Connection refused - nothing is listening on that address and port.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Check the address and any firewall.
errors.tls: The TLS certificate was rejected. Use http:// or a certificate this machine trusts.
errors.docker_down: Docker is not running on that server.
